text:
anya: Quick pulse check on press/analyst plan for launch week. Need final signoffs on embargo time, quote owner, and who handles fact-checks.

jess: I'll own the quotes + the fact-check queue. Drafting three variant lengths (tweet, paragraph, long) now.

marco: Proposed embargo 10:00am PT Tue. Aligns with EMEA morning. Can we confirm that as final?

anya: Yes 10:00am PT is the plan. We'll run a 9:15am PT canary brief with top analysts.

elaine: For brief format, suggest 25-min groups: 10m recap, 10m demo, 5m Q&A. Also recommend adding a slide clarifying on-record vs background.

press-bot: [automated] embargo set: 2026-04-21T10:00:00-07:00. Reminders scheduled at -24h and -1h.

jess: Quote draft (short): "Redwood Inference helps engineering teams run production LLM features with predictable latency and cost." Feedback?

marco: Fine but legal may want "predictable" softened unless we have a verified benchmark.

jess: Swapping to "consistent low-latency" for legal safety. Posting updated drafts.

anya: Assignments: jess -> quotes + fact-check queue; marco -> legal liaison; elaine -> scheduling and attendee gatekeeping.

elaine: Will build a coverage sheet with primary/backup contacts and preferred briefing format. Link in doc when ready.

marco: Note: one analyst asked for embargoed CSVs under a one-way CDA. Product needs to vet. If product can't sign off, we'll offer anonymized ranges.

jess: I'll mark the benchmark slide removable and keep descriptive language until product signs off.

press-bot: [automated reminder] assets checklist: deck, one-pager, FAQ, embargo note, CDA tracker.

anya: Great. We'll reconvene 30m before the canary for final go/no-go. Thanks all :rocket:
